# Craft Agents

## Docs

- [Automations](./automations/overview.md): Automate workflows by triggering actions on app and agent events
- [API Discovery](./browser/api-discovery.md): How the agent discovers internal APIs through network inspection for 100x faster data extraction
- [Examples & Recipes](./browser/examples.md): Practical browser automation recipes — login flows, form filling, data extraction, and more
- [Browser](./browser/overview.md): Control a built-in Chromium browser to automate web tasks, extract data, and interact with any website
- [Conversations](./core-concepts/conversations.md): How conversation history and sessions work
- [Interactions](./core-concepts/interactions.md): Mentions, file attachments, session management, and keyboard shortcuts
- [Permissions](./core-concepts/permissions.md): How Craft Agents handles sensitive operations
- [Projects](./core-concepts/projects.md): Group sessions, assets, and context inside a workspace
- [Working Directory](./core-concepts/working-directory.md): The current working directory (cwd) where your agent executes commands
- [Colors](./customisation/colors.md): Configure colors for labels, statuses, and smart labels using the EntityColor system
- [Icons](./customisation/icons.md): Configure icons for sources, skills, and statuses
- [Themes](./customisation/themes.md): Customize the visual appearance with a 6-color theme system
- [Installation](./getting-started/installation.md): Install the Craft Agents desktop app on macOS, Windows, or Linux
- [Introduction](./getting-started/introduction.md): AI Agent's coding and computer use capabilities, extended for your entire digital workflow
- [Connect to Anything](./go-further/connect-to-anything.md): Use API aggregators to connect 10,000+ services—just ask the agent to set it up
- [Deep Links](./go-further/deeplinks.md): Launch Craft Agents from anywhere using the craftagents:// URL scheme
- [Document Tools](./go-further/document-tools.md): Convert, process, and create documents — Word, Excel, PDF, PowerPoint, images, and more
- [Kanban board](./go-further/kanban.md): Visualize and move sessions across columns with a drag-and-drop board
- [Performance and Token Optimization](./go-further/performance.md): Use RTK to reduce token usage from verbose development commands
- [Rich Output](./go-further/rich-output.md): Interactive tables, diagrams, HTML previews, PDFs, and code diffs — rendered natively in your conversations
- [Sharing Conversations](./go-further/sharing.md): Share your conversations online with a single click
- [Tasks](./go-further/tasks.md): Orchestrate multi-step work with task DAGs, subtasks, and acceptance criteria
- [Workspaces](./go-further/workspaces.md): Organize your configurations with multiple workspaces
- [Auto-Apply Rules](./labels/auto-rules.md): Automatically tag sessions with labels using regex patterns
- [Labels](./labels/overview.md): Organize sessions with colored tags and structured metadata
- [Lark / Feishu](./messaging/lark.md): Connect a Lark or Feishu bot to Craft Agent — long-connection mode, rich-text replies, interactive cards, attachments
- [Messaging](./messaging/overview.md): Drive Craft Agent sessions from Telegram, WhatsApp, or Lark/Feishu — send messages from any device and get agent replies back in the chat
- [Telegram](./messaging/telegram.md): Connect a Telegram bot to Craft Agent — bot-token pairing, attachments, inline buttons
- [WhatsApp](./messaging/whatsapp.md): Connect WhatsApp to Craft Agent via QR pairing — self-chat mode, Baileys worker architecture, attachment support
- [CLI Reference](./reference/cli.md): Complete command reference for the Craft Agents CLI client
- [Configuration File](./reference/config/config-file.md): Reference for ~/.craft-agent/config.json
- [Credentials](./reference/config/credentials.md): How Craft Agents stores sensitive data securely
- [API Providers](./reference/config/custom-endpoint.md): Connect to Anthropic, OpenRouter, Ollama, Vercel AI Gateway, or any compatible endpoint
- [Environment Variables](./reference/config/environment-variables.md): Configure Craft Agents through environment variables
- [LLM Connections](./reference/config/llm-connections.md): Configure multiple AI provider connections (Anthropic, AWS Bedrock, Codex/OpenAI, OpenRouter, and more)
- [Network Proxy](./reference/config/network-proxy.md): Route traffic through an HTTP/HTTPS proxy for corporate networks and firewalls
- [Preferences](./reference/config/preferences.md): Reference for ~/.craft-agent/preferences.json
- [CLI Client](./server/cli.md): Use the Craft Agents CLI to interact with the server from your terminal
- [Remote Server](./server/headless.md): Run Craft Agents as a remote server with browser, desktop, and CLI access
- [Skills](./skills/overview.md): Extend what Craft Agents can do
- [Practical Examples](./sources/apis/curl-examples.md): Real-world API source configurations and usage patterns
